working_features: Pygame window with bordered playing field grid
All 7 standard tetromino pieces with distinct colors
Pieces fall automatically from top
Arrow key left/right movement
Up arrow rotates clockwise
Down arrow soft-drops faster
Pieces lock in place on landing
Completed rows detected and cleared with shifting
Score display and increase on cleared rows
Falling speed increases with level
Next piece preview panel
Game ends when new piece can't be placed
Game over screen shows final score and level
